captureMode: PE metadata/resource/IL read only. HIDMaestro.Core.dll was not loaded as an assembly; no HIDMaestro object, driver, InputHost, virtual controller, physical device, Steam or game was run.

profileAndEncoderProof.profile: dualshock-4-v2 extended report uses gyroPitch/gyroYaw/gyroRoll at int16-le bytes 15/17/19 and accelX/accelY/accelZ at int16-le bytes 21/23/25.
compile: The corresponding IL_0785/078A/078F/0795/079B/07A1 assigns source values 7/8/9/10/11/12.
submit: HMController.SubmitState IL_0249..02A1 selects the extended-report path only when profile ExtendedReport, buffer, encoder state and _extendedModeArmed are present, then calls VendorBlobCodec.EncodeInput.
The non-extended HidReportBuilder path only receives axes/hat/buttons; it is not the DS4 IMU encoder.
encode: VendorBlobCodec.EncodeInput IL_0399..0426 subtracts 7 from the compiled source, switches six cases, reads HMGamepadState GyroPitch/GyroYaw/GyroRoll/AccelX/AccelY/AccelZ in that order, and writes low byte then high byte to B and B+1.
This statically proves profile semantic -> same-named HMGamepadState int16 field -> signed little-endian report field for this locked DS4 encoder.
Whole-assembly reference scan finds HMGamepadState GyroDpsX/Y/Z direct field reads in SwitchProPacker::BuildBody, not in VendorBlobCodec::EncodeInput.

semanticContract: HC reads GamepadMotion.GetRawGyro and GetRawAcceleration (or DSU gyro/accel fallback), not a calibrated-gyro-only substitute.
Each raw gyro axis is RoundClampToShort(Clamp(axis, -2048, 2048) * 16).
Each raw acceleration axis is RoundClampToShort(Clamp(axis * 9.81, -64, 64) * 512).
hcReference.wireBoundary: HC writes these values to a different 31-byte VIIPER report; those HC byte offsets must not be reused for HIDMaestro's 64-byte DS4 v2 report.

currentProductMismatch.inputHost: InputHost/Program.cs:127-136 assigns only float GyroDpsX/Y/Z from gx/gy/gz. It assigns none of the six int16 fields consumed by HIDMaestro's DS4 extended encoder.
currentProductMismatch.nativeTransport: native/main.cpp:5319-5368 transports gx/gy/gz only. It transports no ax/ay/az.
currentProductMismatch.sourceSemantics: native/main.cpp:5486-5495 would replace cgx/cgy/cgz with g_gmGetCal (calibrated gyro) if pairProven became true. That is not the same HC target source as GetRawGyro plus paired raw acceleration.
currentProductMismatch.currentSafety: pairProven is presently hard-coded false at native/main.cpp:5477, so current direct gyro submission is fail-zero. This prevents a nonzero report today but does not repair the future DS4 encoder/transport mismatch.

conclusion: The locked HIDMaestro DS4 encoder axis/index/field-width/endianness ambiguity is closed statically for gyroPitch/gyroYaw/gyroRoll/accelX/accelY/accelZ.
Current product GyroDpsX/Y/Z assignments cannot encode DS4 extended IMU bytes. If that path were later admitted, the unassigned six int16 fields would remain default zero.

A local GyroDps-to-short patch is not HC parity: it would still lack paired raw acceleration and would use calibrated gyro where HC's DS4 target uses raw gyro. Keep direct DS4 IMU safe-stopped until a T12 canonical paired raw gyro+accel transport and descriptor-specific HC scale conversion are implemented and independently decoded.

driver/OS enumeration, Steam/game/consumer observation and recovery
safeStop: dualshock4 direct DS4 IMU remains transport-source-and-readback-unverified; xbox360 remains persona-motion-unsupported.
